name: @pipeworx/mcp-propublica-nonprofit

tools.name: search_nonprofits
tools.description: Search US nonprofits by name. Returns EIN, name, city, state, revenue, assets, and NTEE code. Example: search_nonprofits("red cross", "NY"). Use get_organization with the EIN for full details.

query.description: Name or keyword to search for (e.g., "habitat for humanity")

state.description: Two-letter state code to filter results (e.g., "CA", "NY")

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get full nonprofit details by EIN (Employer Identification Number). Returns organization info plus recent IRS filings with revenue, expenses, and assets. Example: get_organization(131710957).

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (e.g., 131710957 for American Red Cross)

tools.name: get_filing
tools.description: Get a specific IRS filing for a nonprofit. Returns financial data from one tax period including revenue, expenses, assets, and liabilities. Example: get_filing(131710957, 202112).

tax_period.description: Tax period in YYYYMM format (e.g., 202112 for December 2021)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-propublica-nonprofit forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the propublica-nonprofit pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
